scope: Bounded private-final E_COMPILE_WARNING (128) provenance through default reporting and dynamic eval delivery, distinguished from eligible E_WARNING (2) and E_DEPRECATED (8192). Wider compiler warning producers remain required.

cases.source:
<?php
$effects = 0;
$calls = 0;
function compiler_warning_author($level, $message) {
    global $calls;
    ++$calls;
    echo 'handler:', $level, '|';
    echo $message === "The use statement with non-compound name 'BareCompilerWarning' has no effect"
        ? 'message:yes|' : 'BAD:message|';
    return true;
}
error_reporting(128);
set_error_handler('compiler_warning_author');
$returned = eval('class CompileWarningAuthor { final private function hidden() {} }
use BareCompilerWarning;
$effects = 1; return 27;');
echo 'return:', $returned, '|effects:', $effects, '|calls:', $calls;

<?php
$effects = 0;
$calls = 0;
$shared = new Exception('shared');
function compiler_warning_peer($level, $message) {
    global $shared, $calls;
    ++$calls;
    echo $level === 8192 ? 'deprecated|' : 'BAD:level|';
    echo $message === 'NullableWarningPeer(): Implicitly marking parameter $x as nullable is deprecated, the explicit nullable type must be used instead'
        ? 'message:yes|' : 'BAD:message|';
    throw $shared;
}
set_error_handler('compiler_warning_peer');
$returned = 'unset';
try {
    $returned = eval('class CompileWarningPeer { final private function hidden() {} } $effects = 1; return 7;');
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    echo $e === $shared ? 'BAD:early-shared|' : 'BAD:early-other|';
}
echo 'compile-return:', $returned, '|effects:', $effects, '|calls:', $calls, '|';
$returned = 'unset';
try {
    $returned = eval('function NullableWarningPeer(int $x = null) {} $effects = 2; return 9;');
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    echo $e === $shared ? 'same|' : 'BAD:other|';
}
echo 'return:', $returned, '|effects:', $effects, '|calls:', $calls;
